purpose: LLM UI registry: which component to use when, and what it relates to.

components.name: HexIcon
components.title: Foundations/HexIcon
components.description: DERO/SCID hexagon placeholder used when no app icon is available.
useWhen: Missing app icon in result rows, latest finds, or sidebar
avoidWhen: Real app icons exist for the item

components.name: LatestFindItem
components.title: Search/LatestFindItem
components.description: Row in the latest-finds list: icon slot, uppercase domain, app name, SCID and a meta line that can carry a NEW tag and install height.
useWhen: Recent app lists with icon + NEW highlight
Search-card latest finds (icon/meta/scid hidden via SearchCard scope)
avoidWhen: Full search results with ratings and bookmark controls

components.name: LogEntry
components.title: Components/LogEntry
components.description: Single terminal log line: timestamp, level pill, message.

components.name: NoResults
components.title: Components/NoResults
components.description: Empty-state placeholder shown when a list has no items.

components.name: Popover
components.title: Overlays/Popover
components.description: Modal overlay dialog with title, optional message, optional single-line input and an action row. Backdrop click closes. Parent owns visibility via .show()/.hide().
useWhen: Requiring a decision (bookmark save/remove, confirm) with focus on one task
avoidWhen: Onboarding with custom node lists (reuse shell, app adds .onboarding-* body)

components.name: ResultRow
components.title: Search/ResultRow
components.description: Compact representation of one search result with icon, domain, name, SCID, description, rating and bookmark.
useWhen: Listing DERO TELA apps with ratings

components.name: SearchSuggestion
components.title: Search/SearchSuggestion
components.description: Single autocomplete row shown in the search dropdown: primary domain URL with a secondary name/SCID meta line.
useWhen: Autocomplete dropdowns under a search box
avoidWhen: When results need icons or ratings

components.name: StatusDot
components.title: Foundations/StatusDot
components.description: Small colored status indicator (8px dot) for live state.
avoidWhen: Standalone status text without a dot

components.name: TagChip
components.title: Components/TagChip
components.description: Compact removable tag chip with a ✕ button that fires onRemove (rendering the chip list is the parent's job).

components.name: Toast
components.title: Components/Toast
components.description: Transient notification with status dot, message and dismiss button.
useWhen: Reporting operation outcomes briefly (connected, error, warning, pending)

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.title: Components/ToggleSwitch
components.description: Boolean on/off control rendered as a sliding switch. The input is a real checkbox for a11y.
useWhen: Single boolean settings (auto-connect, show top bar, check updates)
